label: Design Voice
description: Generate voice previews from a text description (age, accent, tone, character), and on eleven_ttv_v3 from a reference recording too. Each preview carries its audio and a preview id; wire the one you like into Create Voice to mint it as a durable voice.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (designed voices live in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: What the voice should sound like, in 20 to 1000 characters.
inputs.placeholder: A calm, deep male narrator with a slight British accent

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The line the previews speak, 100 to 1000 characters. Leave empty and ElevenLabs writes a line that suits the description; the `text` output carries the line either way.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: eleven_ttv_v3 is ElevenLabs's human-like, expressive voice design model, for 70+ languages, and the only one that takes `referenceAudio`. eleven_multilingual_ttv_v2 covers 29 languages.

inputs.name: outputFormat
inputs.label: Output format
inputs.description: The format of the previews' audio. opus_48000_* is stored as Ogg Opus. ElevenLabs gives mp3_44100_192 only on its Creator plan and above, and pcm_44100 only on Pro and above.

inputs.name: guidanceScale
inputs.label: Guidance scale
inputs.description: How closely the voice follows the description: lower leaves ElevenLabs more freedom, higher sticks to the description and can sound artificial or robotic. ElevenLabs recommends a longer, more detailed description at a lower value. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 5.

inputs.name: shouldEnhance
inputs.label: Enhance description
inputs.description: Turn on to have ElevenLabs expand a short description into a more detailed one before it designs the voice.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: From -1 to 1: higher gives a better voice but less variety. Leave empty to let ElevenLabs decide.

inputs.name: loudness
inputs.description: How loud the previews are, from -1 (quietest) to 1 (loudest); 0 is roughly -24 LUFS. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 0.5.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: If you want the same voice again, set any whole number here, then run again with that number and the same settings: ElevenLabs says the same seed with the same inputs gives the same voice. Leave empty for a new random seed each run.

inputs.name: referenceAudio
inputs.label: Reference audio
inputs.description: A recording for ElevenLabs to use as a reference when it designs the voice; `promptStrength` sets how much it counts against the description. Only eleven_ttv_v3 takes it.

inputs.name: promptStrength
inputs.label: Prompt strength
inputs.description: How the description and `referenceAudio` are weighed: 0 lets the reference audio decide almost alone, 1 the description. Needs `referenceAudio`.

outputs.name: previews
outputs.description: The generated previews, each with its audio and the `voiceId` Create Voice takes.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The line the previews speak: your `text`, or the one ElevenLabs wrote when it was empty.

then.message: ElevenLabsDesignVoice '{id}' has a `description` under 20 characters, and ElevenLabs takes 20 to 1000: describe the voice in more detail.
ElevenLabsDesignVoice '{id}' has a `description` over 1000 characters, and ElevenLabs takes 20 to 1000: shorten it.
ElevenLabsDesignVoice '{id}' has a `text` under 100 characters, and ElevenLabs speaks a line of 100 to 1000: write a longer line, or leave `text` empty and ElevenLabs writes one.
ElevenLabsDesignVoice '{id}' has a `text` over 1000 characters, and ElevenLabs speaks a line of 100 to 1000: shorten it, or leave `text` empty and ElevenLabs writes one.
ElevenLabsDesignVoice '{id}' gives `referenceAudio`, and ElevenLabs takes reference audio only on eleven_ttv_v3: set `model` to eleven_ttv_v3, or leave `referenceAudio` empty.
ElevenLabsDesignVoice '{id}' sets `promptStrength`, which weighs the description against `referenceAudio`, and no `referenceAudio` is given: wire one in, or leave `promptStrength` empty.
